title: EDHOC+OSCORE c5t handshake bench on EMULATED nRF52840-DK (hw-vs-sim, software ECC)

test.description: Same c5t sw bench firmware as hardware, run against an emulated nRF52840 EDHOC responder (RPL root, node 2). UDGM lossless -> a clean sw handshake-time distribution to compare with the hardware run (BENCH-RESULTS-LOG.md). Passes when the client prints its FINAL summary.
